Information about how data is managed within and outside of Logikcull.

**Updated 04/27/2021**

**Logikcull data sub-processors are listed below, categorized by data type:**

## Logikcull Data Hosting

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ### **3RD-PARTY SERVICE OR VENDOR** | ### **PURPOSE** | ### **LOCATION** |
| Amazon Web Services | Application, data hosting, and processing service platform | United States |

## App-Related Data

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ### **3RD-PARTY SERVICE OR VENDOR** | ### **PURPOSE** | ### **LOCATION** |
| Salesforce | Account management, customer relationship management, in-app chat and email support | United States |
| Mandrill | Transactional notification emails | United States |
| Wistia | In-app video tutorials and related metrics | United States |
| Auth0 | Identity management | United States |
| DialPad | Support Telephony | United States |

| ### **3RD-PARTY SERVICE OR VENDOR** | ### **PURPOSE** | ### **LOCATION** |

| Netsuite | Invoicing and account records | United States |

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ### **3RD-PARTY SERVICE OR VENDOR** | ### **PURPOSE** | ### **LOCATION** |

| Gong.io | Revenue intelligence platform | United States |
